title: birchtree configuration file
description: JSON config loaded by --config=PATH. Every key optional (absent = compiled default). Unknown keys rejected. CLI flags override file values. Units: sizes in bytes, worker_poll_interval_ms in milliseconds.

public_url.description: Public base URL for actor/object URIs (http/https).

max_file_size.description: Max media upload, bytes. No CLI flag; file-only.

max_body_size.description: Max HTTP body, bytes. Must be >= max_file_size.

max_status_chars.description: Max status length (URLs count 23). 500 = Mastodon parity.

worker_poll_interval_ms.description: Worker poll interval, milliseconds. No CLI flag; file-only.

registration_requires_approval.description: Public registration queues accounts for approval.

streaming_api_base_url.description: Advertised streaming base (ws/wss/http/https). Null = serve from public host.

federation_allowlist.description: Private CIDRs federation may reach, e.g. ["10.0.0.0/8"].

federation_extra_ca.description: PEM file of extra TLS trust roots (lab CA).

trends_enabled.description: Serve approved trends. No CLI flag; file-only.

peers_api_enabled.description: Serve GET /api/v1/instance/peers. Default true. No CLI flag; file-only.

activity_api_enabled.description: Serve GET /api/v1/instance/activity. Default true. No CLI flag; file-only.

domain_blocks_public.description: Serve GET /api/v1/instance/domain_blocks. Default false (upstream default hidden). No CLI flag; file-only.

local_live_feed_access.description: Anonymous GET /api/v1/timelines/public (local). Default public. No CLI flag; file-only.

remote_live_feed_access.description: Anonymous public timeline (remote). Default public. No CLI flag; file-only.

local_topic_feed_access.description: Anonymous tag/link timelines (local). Default public. No CLI flag; file-only.

remote_topic_feed_access.description: Anonymous tag/link timelines (remote). Default public. No CLI flag; file-only.

vapid_public_key.description: Base64url VAPID public key for push.

vapid_private_key.description: Base64url VAPID private key. Accepts "env:VAR" indirection. Never logged.

web_client_dir.description: Dir with keystodon's built bundle. Null = /app/* 404s.

invites_enabled.description: Honor invite tokens. No CLI flag; file-only.

smtp_url.description: smtp:// or smtps:// provider URL. Null = mail explicitly disabled (503). Accepts "env:VAR" indirection. No CLI flag; file-only.

mail_from.description: Envelope sender. Required when smtp_url is set. No CLI flag; file-only.
